# peterpan.nl source guide

## Luna quick start · checked 18 October 2026

The public individual-workshop page confirms open workshops and English-speaking chefs, but its visible page has no dates or prices. Follow only its dated agenda when available.

1. Read the individual workshop page for solo/open format and language.
2. Find an individually dated workshop listing before recording an occurrence.
3. Stop if no public date or single-session price is displayed.

Untested controls: Any filter, date picker, schedule link or booking control not explicitly recorded in the observations was not clicked during this audit.

Copyable prompt: “Using https://peterpan.nl/en/cooking-class-amsterdam/agenda-open-cooking-workshop-amsterdam/, find individually dated public entries from {start_date} through {end_date}. Return only fields visibly stated: title, date, start/end, single-visit price, access and language. Mark missing values unknown. Keep missing date, price, access or language unknown. Stop after one bounded public-calendar attempt or at an account, login, booking, payment or security gate. Never infer an occurrence from recurrence.”

## Recheck rules

- Use public, actual date-selectable pages for dated records. A recurring weekly schedule or opening hours is not an occurrence; never expand recurrence.
- Verify that a single visit is allowed for one person, the exact regular single-person price, and any eligibility conditions, class-booking requirements, rentals, or other extras. A gym day pass does not imply group-class admission.
- Keep unknown prices, class inclusion, audience rules, language, dates, and availability unknown. Keep women-only, intro-only, member-only, or other conditions explicit.
- Do not create accounts, book, pay, contact organizers, enter gated flows, or bypass access controls.
- Apply the current profile settings when selecting offerings.
